forward.op: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO svc_analytics;

rollback.op: REVOKE SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM svc_analytics;

principals.subject: svc-analytics@airlock.dev
grants: postgres:SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public
unlocks: Reading every row of customer data in public.*, indefinitely, with no scheduled review
Surviving the departure of everyone who remembers why it was granted

risk_notes.note: The certificate is fine. The change is not. Nothing about this grant is unproven — policy simply does not permit access that never expires, so the gate never opens however good the proof is.
The workable version of this request is a grant that expires nightly and is re-issued by the scheduled export itself, which AIRLOCK can open as a change on its own.

request: The analytics service account needs permanent read access to production so the nightly export stops failing.

exclusions.reason: Cardholder data is out of scope for the on-call role under PCI-DSS 7.2. The grant explicitly excludes it.
No write binding is created. The role is read-only, so the grant cannot be escalated by using it.
